flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then store the exact time shown by the sale countdown timer (for example "Sale ends in 14:59") as timer_first.
Wait 10 seconds.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed again so the page fully loads fresh, and immediately store the time the countdown now shows as timer_after_reload.
Read the second value from the freshly loaded page; do not copy the first value.
If the page has no countdown timer, @v16:"store \"none\" as timer_first and \"none\" as timer_after_reload".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
